commit fa9bcf925a1562db55816bf943aeac03e8cf3a46
Author:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
AuthorDate: Mon May 5 16:55:40 2025 +1200
Commit:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
CommitDate: Mon May 5 16:55:40 2025 +1200

    Bug 1964312 - Port bug 1958299: switch most linux tests to new worker pools based on generic-worker + d2g. rs=bustage-fix DONTBUILD
    Port of https://hg.mozilla.org/mozilla-central/rev/5cbedf2ce27599501164cce8a5a98dae23377c54.

diff --git a/taskcluster/config.yml b/taskcluster/config.yml
index 698b5b67c3c..32d95c04f4e 100644
--- a/taskcluster/config.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/config.yml
@@ -311,6 +311,11 @@ workers:
                 by-release-level:
                     production: comm-3-tree
                     staging: comm-1-tree
+        t-linux-docker(|-noscratch):
+            provisioner: comm-t
+            implementation: docker-worker
+            os: linux
+            worker-type: '{alias}'
         t-linux(-large|-xlarge|-xlarge-source):
             provisioner: comm-t
             implementation: docker-worker
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/clang.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/clang.yml
index d00dc066a2f..ac414af8f0a 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/clang.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/clang.yml
@@ -5,7 +5,7 @@
 task-defaults:
     always-target: true
     platform: linux64/debug
-    worker-type: t-linux-xlarge-source
+    worker-type: t-linux-docker
     attributes:
         code-review: true
     worker:
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/mozlint.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/mozlint.yml
index a2d1c628b1a..8fc3654b648 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/mozlint.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/mozlint.yml
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@ task-defaults:
         kind: test
         tier: 1
     platform: lint/opt
-    worker-type: t-linux-xlarge-source
+    worker-type: t-linux-docker
     worker:
         docker-image: {in-tree: "lint"}
         max-run-time: 1800
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/python.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/python.yml
index 9551f19a6e4..4160bd87202 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/python.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/python.yml
@@ -5,7 +5,7 @@
 task-defaults:
     platform: linux1804-64/opt
     always-target: true
-    worker-type: t-linux-xlarge-source
+    worker-type: t-linux-docker
     worker:
         # A build image instead of the lint image m-c uses, because of the
         # comm-checkout requirement.
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/taskgraph.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/taskgraph.yml
index 024addb7b2c..aa26d1dcc78 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/taskgraph.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/source-test/taskgraph.yml
@@ -5,7 +5,7 @@
 diff:
     description: Generates diffs of CI changes
     platform: linux1804-64/opt
-    worker-type: t-linux-xlarge-source
+    worker-type: t-linux-docker
     worker:
         docker-image: {in-tree: "lint"}
         max-run-time: 1800
